focus.title: 欧盟对华电动车反补贴税终裁落地，中企须关注价格承诺与本地化布局
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于2026年10月底公布对华电动汽车反补贴调查终裁，决定征收为期五年的最终反补贴税，税率因企业配合程度而异。中国出海车企面临出口成本上升与市场份额压力，同时可评估价格承诺、本地化生产及供应链调整等应对路径。建议企业尽快梳理对欧出口产品矩阵，评估关税影响，并关注欧盟成员国执行细则及可能的WTO争端进展。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会贸易司 · 2026.10
focus.title_en: EU Imposes Final Countervailing Duties on Chinese EVs: Price Undertakings and Localization in Focus
focus.summary_en: The European Commission published its final countervailing duty decision on Chinese electric vehicles in late October 2026, imposing five-year duties with rates varying by company cooperation. Chinese exporters face higher costs and market share pressure, and should assess price undertakings, local production and supply chain adjustments. Companies are advised to review their EU export portfolios, quantify tariff exposure, and monitor member state implementation and potential WTO dispute developments.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission DG Trade · Oct 2026

case.title: 新加坡上诉庭明确跨境仲裁中第三方资助披露义务，中企参与仲裁须审慎
case.summary: 新加坡上诉庭近期在一宗国际商事仲裁相关案件中，就第三方资助的披露义务作出指引，强调当事人及代理律师应及时向仲裁庭披露资助安排，否则可能影响仲裁裁决的可执行性。该案对参与新加坡仲裁的中国企业具有警示意义：在涉及第三方资助时，应确保披露合规，避免因程序瑕疵导致裁决在《纽约公约》下被挑战。建议企业建立资助安排审查机制。
case.title_en: Singapore Court of Appeal Clarifies Third-Party Funding Disclosure in Cross-Border Arbitration
case.summary_en: The Singapore Court of Appeal recently issued guidance on disclosure obligations for third-party funding in an international commercial arbitration context, stressing that parties and counsel must promptly disclose funding arrangements to the tribunal, failing which the enforceability of the award may be affected. The case serves as a warning to Chinese companies in Singapore arbitrations: ensure compliant disclosure to avoid challenges under the New York Convention. Companies should establish review mechanisms for funding arrangements.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore Court of Appeal · Oct 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化再扩围，企业须完善数据合规体系
policy.summary: 广东省及深圳市相关部门近期发布粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施，进一步扩展适用行业与场景，允许符合条件的企业在安全评估、标准合同或认证路径下实现数据跨境流动。此举有利于大湾区跨境电商、金融科技及供应链企业提升运营效率。建议企业对照最新目录评估自身数据出境场景，完善个人信息保护影响评估与合同条款，并利用大湾区试点机制降低合规成本。
policy.source: 来源：广东省政务服务数据管理局 · 2026.10
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Expands Cross-Border Data Flow Facilitation: Compliance Upgrades Needed
policy.summary_en: Guangdong and Shenzhen authorities recently issued measures to facilitate cross-border data flows in the Greater Bay Area, further expanding eligible industries and scenarios. Qualified companies may transfer data under security assessment, standard contract or certification pathways. This benefits e-commerce, fintech and supply chain firms. Companies should assess their data export scenarios against the latest catalogue, improve impact assessments and contract terms, and leverage pilot mechanisms to reduce compliance costs.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Government Services and Data Management Bureau · Oct 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规收紧，中企须重构跨境交易合规路径
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期进一步收紧对外投资审查规则，扩大敏感技术领域范围并强化申报要求。中国企业在涉及美国技术、资金或人员的跨境交易中，须提前进行投资审查筛查，识别是否触发申报义务，并评估交易架构调整空间。建议在交易前期引入法律尽调，设计分步交割与风险隔离机制，同时关注中国反制法规的适用，避免双重合规冲突。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Tightened US Outbound Investment Rules Require Rethinking Cross-Border Compliance
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US has further tightened outbound investment review rules, expanding sensitive technology sectors and strengthening notification requirements. Chinese companies involved in cross-border transactions with US technology, capital or personnel should conduct early screening to identify filing obligations and assess restructuring options. We recommend legal due diligence at the outset, designing staged closing and risk isolation mechanisms, and monitoring China's countermeasures to avoid dual compliance conflicts.
